name: Studiomate
summary: A friendly twelve-page CRM for small studios: clients, deals, meetings, email and time
about: A CRM for a design studio, agency or freelancer team, in soft pastel blocks. It has a working inbox with replies, templates and a paper-plane send, a month calendar you drag meetings around, a sticky-note deal board, proposals, projects, a live time tracker, files and reports, all with sample data from a Karachi studio.
how: Open any of the twelve pages from the grouped sidebar; on a phone use the menu button.
In Inbox, pick a thread, star, archive or delete it, write a reply or compose a new email from a template and watch it fly off.
On Meetings, drag a meeting chip to another day (undo in the toast), click + on a day to book one, or move between months.
On Deals, peel a sticky note off and stick it in the next column; keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip.
Write proposals, mark them accepted, and track project budgets and progress.
On Time, press play to start the timer for a project and stop it to log the hours; add or edit entries by hand.
Upload, rename and delete files, read the Reports, and change the signature, nudges, theme or reset the demo in Settings.
